## How I found it

The two feature groups (`train_skew` v1, `serve_skew` v1) existed on the platform but were empty, so I ingested the CSVs with `hops fg insert`, then joined and compared them entirely platform-side via Trino:

```sql
SELECT AVG(ABS(t.fN - s.fN)), MAX(ABS(t.fN - s.fN)) ...
FROM train_skew_1 t JOIN serve_skew_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
```

| feature | mean \|Δ\| | max \|Δ\| |

| f1, f2, f4, f5 | 0.0 | 0.0 |

## Cause

f3 is **log1p-transformed in the training path but served raw at inference**. The relationship `train_f3 = ln(serve_f3 + 1)` holds for every row to floating-point precision (max residual ~5e-7, just CSV rounding) — verified on the platform with `MAX(ABS(t.f3 - ln(s.f3 + 1)))`. Equivalently, the online service serves `exp(train_f3) - 1`, i.e. it skips the log1p transform the training pipeline applied.
